rationale: C17 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. Both orders implement an international health or safety instrument by reciting the United States’ undertaking with other governments to give effect to it, identifying its effective date, explaining that executive-branch performance is necessary for “full and complete effect,” and then assigning the instrument’s prescribed duties to the agency already possessing related statutory functions. The close, distinctive verbal and structural parallels substantially exceed generic treaty-implementation language. C10 and C08 have weaker parallels in coordinating multiple agencies and allocating functions, but lack C17’s unusually close recital sequence and phrasing.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the Government of the United States of America, together with the governments of the other countries which have become parties to the Convention, undertakes to give effect to the provisions of the said Convention
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the Government of the United States of America, together with the governments of other countries which have accepted the said Constitution, undertakes to give effect to regulations of the World Health Assembly
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive near-parallel language describes a joint international undertaking to give effect to an adopted instrument.

shared_material.child_excerpt: in order that the Government of the United States of America may give full and complete effect to the said Convention, that several departments and agencies of the executive branch ... perform functions and duties thereunder
shared_material.parent_excerpt: in order that the Government of the United States of America may give full and complete effect to the said regulations ... it is necessary that an agency of the executive branch ... be designated to exercise functions and perform duties under the said regulations
shared_material.explanation: The child closely adapts the parent’s necessity recital, expanding from one agency to several.

shared_material.child_excerpt: are hereby directed ... to perform the functions and duties therein prescribed and undertaken which appertain to the functions and duties which they severally are now directed or authorized by law to perform
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I hereby designate the Surgeon General ... for the purpose of performing the duties prescribed and undertaken in the said International Sanitary Regulations
shared_material.explanation: Both operative provisions assign duties prescribed by the international instrument to agencies already responsible for the relevant domestic functions.
